title: Lisa's birth chart
metaDescription: Lisa's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 6.6° Aries. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Aries: the Sun, Mercury, Venus and Saturn. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Aries, but precisely: 6.6°, first decan, 0° to 10°, under Mars in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 21.4° Aries; Venus stands at 5.0° Aries; Mars stands at 23.0° Virgo. The tradition reads a mind that decides at speaking speed from Mercury, taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate from Venus, drive that grinds rather than flares from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Venus to Pluto, a trine with 0.6° of slack. Trines are read as inheritance rather than achievement: the ease is genuine, and nothing about it was earned. Behind it, the Sun trine Pluto at 1.1°, and the Sun sextile Uranus at 1.2°, both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held. The tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Four planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. The Sun in Aries at 6.6° is in exaltation (the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best); the Moon in Scorpio at 10.6° is in fall (the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given); Venus in Aries at 5.0° is in detriment (the planet opposite its home, working against the grain); Saturn in Aries at 9.8° is in fall. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 5 fire, 2 earth, 2 air, 1 water; by modality, 5 cardinal, 3 fixed, 2 mutable. Fire leads with ignition: the first move made early, and certainty arriving ahead of the evidence. Mars and Pluto were retrograde (apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first).

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Scorpio for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.6° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 10.6°.
